title: Tracking work orders
summary: Advance production runs from issuing components to receiving finished goods.

steps.text: Open {wip} from the sidebar to see production runs on the floor.
Status cards split the queue by stage, from {planned} to {hold} to {done}; tick runs and choose an action from the bulk actions above the table to move them along.

A run that yields extras, such as oil cake beside oil, has a quantity box for each one in its row on the product's {tab} tab, filled with what is still to come. Change it to what was really made before you choose Complete, and enter 0 for an extra that was not made or was thrown away. Completing runs from this page receives each extra's planned quantity.
A run that ended with materials still held asks to be reconciled: its page lists what it holds so you can record what was used, returned or lost.
You can also ask the assistant how a work order stands, or to start, hold, issue materials to, receive or complete it. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
